quiz.title: TELLY WEEK
quiz.greeting: Don't touch that dial! This week it's all about the telly. Press red to begin.
quiz.share: I scored {score}/12 on Flummox!, the Teletext quiz on STEEVEFAX page 152. Can you flummox Felix?

verdicts.text: Felix is utterly FLUMMOXED! A perfect game.
Not bad. Felix has seen worse.
Felix is not flummoxed in the slightest.
